name: Mikazuki Juuichi
source:
Juuichi is a senior in high school. He is also an expert at Judo. Even though his face makes it look like he's in a bad mood all the time, he really isn't. He seems to hate being called fat, remaking such comments as him being "big-boned" or that his fat is muscle. Juuichi also has a younger twin brother.

[From [url=http://en.wikifur.com/wiki/Morenatsu]Wikifur[/url]]
